axioms.mathematical_meaning: Absolute summability of the integrals of the actual alternating geometric mode norms for every pair of monomial indices.

coverage: Concrete printed beta4 density and mode definitions plus one convergence prerequisite; no moment identity or beta hyperbolicity conclusion assumed.
repair_gate: Do not treat pointwise positive density as positivity of the bilinear coefficient form. Preserve the printed normalization and audit it against exact low-index moments before accepting any target conclusion.
object_interface_work: Prove each mode is integrable using existing arbitrary-order Mellin logarithmic integrals; identify pointwise geometric expansion; justify integral/tsum interchange; construct and identify the actual beta series and rational harmonic tails; only then transport the true coefficient pencil to finite positive-slope spectrum.
discharge_obligations: Replace summability axiom by exact Mellin term estimates and a convergent numerical majorant. The series-to-beta moment identity and all finite-pencil identifications remain separate work.
